messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@violethealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@violethealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Marketplace bundle + co-term at renewal

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the connector bundle in the marketplace. We have procurement and engineering aligned to add the Marketplace Connect bundle (5 connectors) but we need the commercial to be co-termed to our existing Redwood renewal (2027-08-01). Procurement also asked if Redwood can provide a short-term credit to offset the mid-cycle pro-rata charge while we align billing.

High-level asks:
- Add Marketplace Connect (5 connectors) as an add-on effective immediately.
- Co-term to 2027-08-01 (align invoices).
- One-time credit to reduce the pro-rated charge for the remainder of this quarter (we're flexible on structure).

I've attached a short requirements sheet and procurement contact for PO. Can you send a proposed amendment and rough commercial today? If we can get sign-off quickly we can onboard connectors in June.

Procurement lead: procurement@violethealth.com
Cheers,

Claire Barnes
Head of Integrations, Violet Health
claire@violethealth.com
[attachment: VioletHealth_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@violethealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace bundle + co-term at renewal

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and for the quick turnaround. Happy to get this moving. Summary of what we can do today: 

1) Commercial proposal (high level) — two options:
   • Option A (preferred): Add connectors now at list price, apply a one-time "onboarding credit" equal to 30% of the pro-rated charge for the remainder of this quarter to offset the mid-cycle hit. Co-term the add-on to 2027-08-01 (no change to renewal rate).
   • Option B: Discounted quarterly trial: 50% off for first 30 days then roll to standard rates; co-term on 2027-08-01.

2) Amendment: I'll attach a short amendment (draft) that 1) adds the Marketplace Connect SKU, 2) defines the credit amount and 3) elects co-term. Legal will need to sign off on the language for credits.

3) Procurement/PO: We can accept a PO for the add-on. Std payment terms are Net 30; if procurement needs Net 45 we can review with Finance. Please confirm the billing contact and PO timeline.

Next steps I propose:
- I will circulate RH_amendment_draft_v1.pdf to you and loop in Sales Ops for final margin check.
- Ben — can you approve an onboarding credit up to 30% for this add-on (this is a one-time credit, not a recurring discount)? If it needs to exceed 30% we will need leadership approval.
- Priyom — once we have the final wording can you prepare a DocuSign envelope and check whether the credit language requires any special finance code?

Onward — I can get the draft over within an hour.

Best,
Olga
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
[attachment: RH_amendment_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)]
